classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

assumptions: GO:0097163 is used as the best available GO term for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity; this term covers the NAD(P)HX dehydratase function including ADP-dependent bacterial and archaeal variants; if go_seqs_dehydratase returns zero results, consult lit_nadhx_repair output for the current precise GO identifier
GO:0097166 is used as the best available GO term for NADPHX epimerase activity; if go_seqs_epimerase returns zero results, consult lit_nadhx_repair output for the current precise GO identifier
Only reviewed (Swiss-Prot) UniProt entries are retrieved to maximise annotation quality; IEA evidence is excluded to ensure manually curated GO assignments
sequence_analysis is applied per-activity FASTA batch; the fasta_path field name is assumed from standard go_sequences output schema and may require adjustment if the actual schema differs

ESM3 is retained as a warm tool but is not included in workflow nodes because the esm3 tool requires a single resolved sequence string; FASTA output from go_sequences cannot be dereferenced to individual sequence strings within a single planning step; ESM3 embeddings should be applied on top-ranked candidates from rank_designs in a follow-up workflow
lit_nadhx_repair provides contextual evidence for GO term validation and organism coverage; it does not auto-parameterise subsequent nodes in this plan
No taxon filter is applied so that phylogenetically diverse representatives spanning bacteria, archaea, and eukaryotes are all considered for ranking
rank_designs scores candidates primarily on compositional, charge, and motif-level evidence from sequence_analysis; no experimental fitness data or structure predictions are available at this stage
plan.goal: Retrieve all reviewed UniProt sequences for NAD(P)HX repair enzymes carrying ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0097163) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0097166) activities, annotate each sequence with compositional, charge, and motif-level biochemical properties, and produce a top-10 ranked list of representative candidates with composite biochemical scores

success_criteria.literature_coverage: lit_nadhx_repair returns ≥5 publications spanning 2011–2026 covering NAD(P)HX repair GO terms and representative organisms
success_criteria.dehydratase_sequences: go_seqs_dehydratase returns ≥5 reviewed sequences annotated with GO:0097163
success_criteria.epimerase_sequences: go_seqs_epimerase returns ≥5 reviewed sequences annotated with GO:0097166
success_criteria.analysis_completeness: seq_analysis_dehydratase and seq_analysis_epimerase each produce per-sequence composition, charge, and motif annotations for all retrieved sequences
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_nadhx_candidates outputs top_k=10 representative candidates with composite biochemical scores across both activity classes
